description: Stop a key working. Anything still using it is refused within a minute or two, on every address the app has, so confirm with the person which key they mean first. If it answers EDGE_NOT_UPDATED, call it again: the key is revoked, and repeating tells the edge again.

project.description: Project id (prj_…) or the app's name (slug). Defaults to the project in deploy.json in the current directory.

name: revoke_api_key
title: Revoke an API key
